name: Refurbished channel for datacenter accelerators - ITAD and refurbisher market
publisher: IT Creations / derived from multiple repo records
notes: DERIVED ANALYSIS from existing repo records (sup-used-compucycle, sup-used-equipnet-auctions, sup-used-itcreations-gpu, itad-upstream-equipnet-compucycle). The refurbished channel for datacenter GPUs operates through ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) companies, refurbishers, and auction houses. Key players: Compucycle, EquipNet, IT Creations, ServerPartDeals. The channel sources GPUs from hyperscale datacenter decommissioning, corporate upgrades, and financial distress sales. Pricing in the used market (from market-gpu-price-bands-2026-10): H100 80GB PCIe $32,000-$47,520 (median $43,000, n=8); H100 80GB SXM5 $24,118-$28,888 (median $26,880, n=5); A100 80GB $16,798-$34,999 (median $21,995, n=17); H800 80GB $33,900-$41,221 (n=2). The refurbished channel offers 30-50% savings vs new retail, but with risks: no warranty (or limited warranty), unknown remaining lifespan, no manufacturer support, and potential for hidden defects (mining damage, thermal stress). The channel is most active for previous-generation GPUs (A100, H100) as hyperscalers upgrade to H200/B200. The H100 SXM5 used market is the most liquid datacenter GPU secondary market. | DEAD-LINK VERIFIED 2026-10-04. THREE independent GET probes returned HTTP 404.
